It´s official: Harry Kane has won the Ballon D'Or!
One of the best individual seasons the world has ever seen - crowned with the highest individual award in football! Harry Kanes 2025/26-season was one for the history books. 72 goals, trophies, assists, big performances in big games - the numbers speak for themselves! Enjoy this compilation showing Harry Kanes best moments in the Bundesliga from last season. Congratulations Harry! Which moment was your favorite? Let us know in the comments!
